```{ojs}
viewof auControls = {
  const sampleSizeForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([1, 100], {
      value: 1,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<details class="controls-root" open>
    <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
    <div class="controls-grid">
      <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample size</h4></div>
    </div>
  </details>`;

  root.querySelector(".controls-col").append(sampleSizeForm);
  const update = () => {
    root.value = {...sampleSizeForm.value};
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };

  sampleSizeForm.addEventListener("input", update);
  queueMicrotask(update);
  return root;
}

auSampleSize = auControls.n

auTarget = 0
auFixedSd = 0.8
auBias = 2 / Math.sqrt(auSampleSize)
auExpectedValue = auTarget + auBias

auDensity = d3.range(281).map(index => {
  const x = -3 + index * 8 / 280;
  const y = Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - auExpectedValue) / auFixedSd) ** 2) /
    (auFixedSd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  return {x, y};
})

auBiasPath = d3.range(1, 101).map(n => ({
  n,
  bias: 2 / Math.sqrt(n)
}))
```

```{ojs}
auDensityPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 315,
  marginLeft: 54,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Possible estimate θ̂ₙ", domain: [-3, 5]},
  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, 0.57], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(auDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-2)"
    }),
    Plot.line(auDensity, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-2)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([auTarget], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([auExpectedValue], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.text([
      {x: auTarget, y: 0.53, label: "target θ"},
      {x: auExpectedValue, y: 0.46, label: "centre E[θ̂ₙ]"}
    ], {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      text: "label",
      textAnchor: "start",
      dx: 7,
      fill: point => point.label === "target θ" ?
        "var(--plot-fg)" : "var(--plot-series-4)",
      fontSize: 12
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})

auBiasPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 315,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Sample size n", domain: [1, 100], grid: true},
  y: {label: "Bias E[θ̂ₙ] − θ", domain: [0, 2.12], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(auBiasPath, {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-3)"
    }),
    Plot.line(auBiasPath, {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-3)",
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.dot([{n: auSampleSize, bias: auBias}], {
      x: "n",
      y: "bias",
      r: 6,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      stroke: "var(--plot-on-accent)",
      strokeWidth: 1.3
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="au-figure-shell">
  <div class="au-plots">
    <div class="au-plot-panel">
      <strong>Sampling distribution at the selected ${tex`n`}</strong>
      ${auDensityPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="au-plot-panel">
      <strong>What happens to the bias as ${tex`n`} grows?</strong>
      ${auBiasPlot}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="au-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    θ = ${auTarget}; E[θ̂ₙ] = ${auExpectedValue.toFixed(3)};
    Bias(θ̂ₙ) = ${auBias.toFixed(3)}; sd(θ̂ₙ) = ${auFixedSd.toFixed(1)}
  </div>
  <div class="controls-wrap">${viewof auControls}</div>
  <p class="au-message"><strong>Watch the centre, not the width.</strong> As ${tex`n`} increases, the red centre moves towards ${tex`\theta`} and the bias approaches zero. The spread is deliberately held fixed: this sequence is asymptotically unbiased, but it is <em>not</em> consistent.</p>
</div>

<style>
  .au-figure-shell { color: var(--plot-fg); }

    display: flex;

</style>`
```
